name: Canada Digital Adoption Program (CDAP)
eligibilitySummary: Grants for Canadian small businesses to adopt digital technologies. Provides funding for e-commerce, digital marketing, and technology implementation. For businesses with 1-99 employees.

funding.description: Up to $2,500 for micro-grants for technology adoption; up to $15,000 for Boost Your Business Technology stream

application.applicationRequirements: Must be a for-profit business registered in Canada with 1-99 employees and at least one year of operation.
